name: g_PlaneDynamics_TuningBlock
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Base of a 312-byte block (78 dwords) that 007EAAE1 REP MOVSD fills from ESI=EBP+210h inside 007E2A20 BSP_GameTuning_LoadFromPlaneGlobals; ECX=4Eh at 007EAAD7, EDI=0F872F0h at 007EAADC, bytes F3 A5 so a copy and not a STOSD fill. ESI is provably still EBP+210h at the copy: the function mentions ESI fifteen times in 6454 instructions and writes it twice, XOR ESI,ESI at 007E2A61 and LEA ESI,[EBP+210h] at 007E2D03. The block therefore mirrors singleton fields +210h..+348h, whose names and Lua property paths include/bsp/game_tuning_singleton.hpp already carries (+210h Dynamics/Ceiling onward). Consequence worth recording: only 00F872F0 carries an xref from this write, so an xref negative on any of the other 77 globals means no literal-address writer and NOT no writer. docs/PLANE_CONTROL_RATE_LAW.md.

name: g_PlaneDynamics_RotationFactorA
evidence: Hypothesis from the loader, not a recovered symbol. Read only by 007DA710 BSP_PlaneFlight_ControlRateLaw, at 007DABB2 (pitch), 007DAD4E (yaw) and 007DAED0 (roll), each time as the quadratic coefficient of the axis delta. Written at runtime, not statically: this is past .data's file-backed extent (va=00E08000 vsize=00297EDC rawsize=00010000) so its static 0.0 is loader zero-fill and proves nothing. The writer is the REP MOVSD at 007EAAE1 (bytes F3 A5, ECX=4Eh=78 dwords) copying from ESI=EBP+210h in 007E2A20 BSP_GameTuning_LoadFromPlaneGlobals, which xrefs only 00F872F0. Block offset +0Ch maps to the singleton field at +21Ch, which include/bsp/game_tuning_singleton.hpp:172 records as Dynamics/RotationFactors/A; 007E3CBE stores it after a BSP_LuaObject_GetNumber keyed on the string "A" at 00CE608C. This installation's planeglobals.lua gives 0.5. docs/PLANE_CONTROL_RATE_LAW.md.

name: g_PlaneDynamics_RotationFactorB
evidence: Hypothesis from the loader, not a recovered symbol. Read only by 007DA710 at 007DABCE, 007DAD5A and 007DAEDD as the linear coefficient of |delta|. Same runtime-write story as 00F872FC: zero-fill statically, written by the REP MOVSD at 007EAAE1. Block offset +10h -> singleton +220h = Dynamics/RotationFactors/B (game_tuning_singleton.hpp:173), stored at 007E3D00 after a GetNumber keyed on the string "B" at 00CE60E4. This installation's planeglobals.lua gives 1.5, which is also the hard-coded reverse-crossing floor multiplier at 00CE3D78 - the same coefficient applied to the deflection instead of the error. docs/PLANE_CONTROL_RATE_LAW.md.

name: g_PlaneDynamics_RotationFactorC
evidence: Hypothesis from the loader, not a recovered symbol. Read only by 007DA710 at 007DABD6, 007DAD62 and 007DAEE5 as the constant term of the rate polynomial. Same runtime-write story as 00F872FC. Block offset +14h -> singleton +224h = Dynamics/RotationFactors/C (game_tuning_singleton.hpp:174), stored at 007E3D42 after a GetNumber keyed on the string "C" at 00D08204, beside which 00D08208 holds the section string RotationFactors. This installation's planeglobals.lua gives 0.1, just under the 0.15f idle floor at 00CE3D30, so the floor takes over as an axis converges. docs/PLANE_CONTROL_RATE_LAW.md.
